About Ethena

Ethena is the protocol behind USDe, a synthetic dollar backed by crypto collateral and hedged with derivatives positions. ENA is its governance token.

Where this ENA price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (ENA-USD), Binance (ENA/USDT) and Kraken (ENA/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 6.89B ENA (supply last updated October 30, 2026). Prices on different exchanges can differ slightly; the table above shows each one and the spread between them.
